title: build(deps-dev): bump @types/node from 26.4.1 to 26.6.1 in /packages/client
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. Types-only devDependency bump inside the existing ^26 range. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid; that friction is the point.
behavior_change: None at runtime. DevDependency typings only. Lockfile enumerated by parsing both package-lock.json trees to JSON and comparing every entry under `packages` (412 entries before and after, 0 added, 0 removed): exactly two versions move, both upward and both dev=true -- @types/node 26.4.1 -> 26.6.1 and its transitive undici-types 8.3.0 -> 8.9.0. NO non-dev package moved and nothing was reverted. The declared range in package.json moves ^26.4.1 -> ^26.6.1, which is inside the range already in force.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares @types/node ^26.6.1 (was ^26.4.1). packages/client/package-lock.json resolves @types/node 26.6.1 and undici-types 8.9.0. No other lockfile entry changed in either direction.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. The bump is already open as PR #391 and both CBSP21 gates fail there for want of a manifest of its own; this is that manifest.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No production dependency. No source file. No build, lint or test configuration. The Node engines range stays ^20.19.0 || >=22.22.2 and is not touched by this bump.

commands_run: python - <<parse both package-lock.json trees with json.load and diff every `packages` entry>> -> 412 entries before and after, 0 added, 0 removed, exactly 2 version movements: node_modules/@types/node 26.4.1->26.6.1 dev=True and node_modules/undici-types 8.3.0->8.9.0 dev=True; non-dev packages moved: 0
manual_verifications: Lockfile was enumerated by parsing both JSON trees, NOT by reading the diff view. The truncated diff view is how PR #296 landed a supabase bump that silently reverted zod 4 to 3; the enumeration above is the check that would have caught it.

Merge-risk note recorded rather than assumed: packages/client type-check and lint are `continue-on-error: true` in .github/workflows/client_lint_build.yml (lines 42 and 46, the former annotated '400+ pre-existing type errors'), and `vite build` strips types rather than checking them. Nothing blocking in CI validates TypeScript types, so a green run on this PR is not evidence that the new typings type-check cleanly. This is a pre-existing property of the lane, not a regression introduced here.

Pre-existing and NOT introduced by this bump: packages/client declares engines ^20.19.0 || >=22.22.2 while @types/node is a ^26 line, and client_lint_build.yml provisions Node 20.x. The typings therefore describe a newer runtime than the floor the package supports. The branch was already on 26.4.1, so this bump perpetuates that mismatch rather than creating it; flagged here so it is visible rather than inherited silently.
